request.prompt:
Domain: river-valley flood damage (this is a flood study, not fire, not earthquake — frame accordingly). Processes such surveys consider include: water draining safely through debris; debris forming a dam that holds; water ponding behind debris and later releasing suddenly; new slope failures on other reaches; continued flooding downstream only; or nothing further happening. These are vocabulary, not answers: you may adopt, adapt, or reject any of them, but your set must stay open and include a nothing-happens story with real weight. Ground every weight in the ledger below, not in the vocabulary above.
Context: a river-valley damage survey, one pre-cutoff snapshot, anonymous reaches (Alpha upstream, Beta downstream), one anonymized tributary. Below is the evidence ledger (pre-cutoff aggregates only).
Propose an OPEN mechanism set that includes a nothing-happens story with real weight, per-fact weights, and a spatial cluster rule. Reply with JSON only: {"mechanisms": [{"id", "title", "supports": [fact ids], "opposes": [fact ids], "prior"}], "weights": {fact id: number}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": number, "min_features": number}}. Cite only ledger facts, using their FULL ids exactly as written in the ledger lines below; any abbreviated id invalidates the draft. Assert no outcome.
Ledger facts:
- F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage: 2092 destroyed features predate the cutoff
- F2_upstream_share: upstream reach holds 51.5% of pre-cutoff damage
- F3_channel_adjacent_share: 72.8% of pre-cutoff damage lies within channel-adjacent distance of mapped waterways
- F4_cluster_hit: frozen tributary-cluster rule: HIT (34 pre-cutoff features near the target reach)
- F5_upstream_density_ratio: upstream damage density is 1.06x downstream density
- F6_extent_context: static observed flood outline present as context (no time signal)
- F7_target_reach_share: 1.6% of pre-cutoff damage lies near the target tributary reach
- F8_inputs_audit_clean: input audit verifies: every prediction byte pinned pre-cutoff

response.text: {"mechanisms": [{"id": "M1", "title": "Permeable debris - water drains safely through debris without ponding", "supports": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share", "F5_upstream_density_ratio", "F8_inputs_audit_clean"], "opposes": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage"], "prior": 0.18}, {"id": "M2", "title": "Stable debris dam holds - sustained ponding upstream of blockage", "supports": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F6_extent_context"], "opposes": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share", "F5_upstream_density_ratio"], "prior": 0.15}, {"id": "M3", "title": "Transient ponding and sudden release - debris dam breach outburst flood", "supports": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F7_target_reach_share"], "opposes": ["F5_upstream_density_ratio", "F2_upstream_share"], "prior": 0.12}, {"id": "M4", "title": "Distributed new slope failures on other reaches", "supports": ["F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F2_upstream_share", "F5_upstream_density_ratio"], "opposes": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F7_target_reach_share"], "prior": 0.15}, {"id": "M5", "title": "Continued fluvial flooding downstream only - no debris dam involvement", "supports": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share", "F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F2_upstream_share"], "opposes": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F7_target_reach_share"], "prior": 0.18}, {"id": "M6", "title": "Nothing further happens - no additional flood damage beyond pre-cutoff snapshot", "supports": ["F7_target_reach_share", "F5_upstream_density_ratio", "F6_extent_context", "F8_inputs_audit_clean"], "opposes": ["F4_cluster_hit", "F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage"], "prior": 0.22}], "weights": {"F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage": 0.15, "F2_upstream_share": 0.1, "F3_channel_adjacent_share": 0.2, "F4_cluster_hit": 0.18, "F5_upstream_density_ratio": 0.1, "F6_extent_context": 0.05, "F7_target_reach_share": 0.12, "F8_inputs_audit_clean": 0.1}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": 150, "min_features": 30}}
